result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, my top two recommendations are **1Password and Bitwarden**\. Both are strong choices, but they appeal to slightly different teams.

If I were choosing a password manager for a company with 5–20 employees, here's my shortlist.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

(Best overall experience)

**1\. 1Password**

Best for teams that want simplicity, excellent sharing and strong administration.

- Shared vaults for departments or projects
- Granular access permissions
- Easy employee onboarding and offboarding
- Strong security and admin controls

Teams Starter Pack: approximately US\$24.95/month for up to 10 users, billed annually.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

(Best value)

**2\. Bitwarden**

Best for cost-conscious teams that still want serious security features.

- Open-source software
- Shared collections
- Admin and audit tools
- Cross-platform support
- Self-hosting options

Teams: approximately US\$4/user/month, billed annually.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

Best for teams wanting centralized administration and security controls.

- Shared team folders
- Role-based access
- Admin console
- Security reporting

Business Starter: approximately US\$2/user/month, subject to plan requirements.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Proton Pass Plus - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ieWxaf1V1oKwR5RRYZyCUPTssuPFmf3KGImAFxDImLo918b9HrqSkmcFxYOmTtZlPSYlBfMDN2fRfrT9cxgSPcskegAU9CMbarL_OHz9CIE3qqDdr6RF19eJVNxO2Ol4ntEKr3D7ZAQzGf8y8YfFA_bGj9p5D2RwqWU6uGCUEvGwoAX0vUa7O4BZUHkNpExF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

Best for privacy-focused organizations.

- End-to-end encrypted vaults
- Secure credential sharing
- Email aliases
- Privacy-oriented ecosystem

Business plans start around US\$1.99/user/month.

[Proton Pass for business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Prices are approximate published annual-billing prices as of November 2026, before taxes. Regional pricing and plan eligibility vary. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Best overall usability | 1Password |
| Best value for money | Bitwarden |
| Strong administration | Keeper |
| Privacy-focused | Proton Pass |


For most small businesses, I'd choose **1Password** if the budget allows, or **Bitwarden** if keeping costs down is important.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I can make a more precise recommendation if I know a little about your team.

**1\. How many people are on your team?**
